title: Ashvale Rising Anew
author: Ada Lockridge
blurb: Rafael Pemberton, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
